_comment: Seed-spread experiment ONLY -- not training, not eval. Its own config name so the two arms are separable from game_meta.json alone rather than from which directory they were written to; mtg-d1's population guard keys on this field. Identical to corpus-boros-mirror-q34b in every other respect: same deck, same frozen notalk-strategy prompt, same Qwen3-4B. The arms differ ONLY in the seed, which is recorded per game alongside the temperature so that claim is assertable from the artefacts.
